summary: Full regression for Celesta Glow Jan 2026 fixes: referral ₹50 cashback, WELCOME50 coupling, min order ₹500, 7-day hold, withdrawal queue, cosmetics stable sort, add-to-cart toast, employee/products routing, theme-color. 13/13 backend tests pass; all frontend flows verified.
critical_code_review_comments: referral_service._promote_withdrawable_balance is called on every customer-summary read — fine for current scale but consider batching if referrers grow beyond ~10k.
test_referral_purchase hard-codes order_id/phone; could collide across rapid test runs — not a production bug but may flake in stress tests.

Withdrawal happy-path in service assumes earnings_withdrawable is in sync with order-level `cashback_status='withdrawable'` count; if they drift (manual DB edit) mark-paid may mis-flag orders. Not a launch blocker.
seed_data_creation: Created employee 'testemp_jan2026' (retained for re-testing). Test-only referrals seeded inside tests are cleaned up via fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are pytest-native at /app/backend/tests/test_referral_and_products.py (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + MONGO_URL from .env: `export $(grep -v ^# /app/frontend/.env /app/backend/.env | xargs)`). Employee testemp_jan2026 is persisted; delete with DELETE /api/admin/employees/testemp_jan2026 + X-Admin-Token if cleanup desired.
verified_behaviors: GET /api/referral/customer-summary returns earnings_withdrawable/pending/paid, cashback_per_referral=50, min_order_amount=500, return_window_days=7, orders[]
POST /api/referral/request-withdrawal: 400 on zero balance, 200 on balance>0 (WR_ id), 400 on duplicate pending request
GET /api/admin/withdrawal-requests returns {success, requests[]}; 401 without X-Admin-Token; status filter works
POST /api/admin/withdrawal-requests/{id}/mark-paid moves ₹ from earnings_withdrawable to earnings_paid and returns success; 400 on unknown id
GET /api/products?niche=cosmetics&page=1&limit=50&sort=sort_order — identical slug ordering across two consecutive calls (slug tie-breaker works)
GET /api/products (legacy) returns plain array capped at 5000
Homepage add-to-cart: green 'Added to bag' toast appears + cart badge count increments from 0 to 1
/cosmetics home page products render in identical order across reloads (12/12 slugs identical)
/employee/login → /employee/dashboard → /employee/products renders admin Catalog Management UI with 28 products (NO 'Under Construction'). Menu shows Products + Retention.
